title: Cheapest Connection Network for the Transit System
real_world_story: A public-transport authority wants to build the cheapest set of connections that links all its stations so that passengers can travel between any two stations. Some potential connections are cheaper to build than others. Choosing the right subset of connections with minimum total cost is the goal.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Stations as nodes and candidate connections as weighted edges representing build cost
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Building a minimum spanning tree that connects all stations

problem_statement: Given N stations and M candidate connections, each with a build cost, find the minimum total cost of connections such that all N stations are connected. If it is impossible to connect all stations, print -1.
task: Compute the minimum total cost to connect all stations.
input_format: The first line contains two integers N and M, where N is the number of stations (numbered 1 to N) and M is the number of candidate connections. The next M lines each contain three integers U, V and C indicating a candidate connection between station U and station V with build cost C.
output_format: Print the minimum total cost to connect all stations. If the network is disconnected and cannot be fully connected, print -1.

examples.explanation: Selecting connections (2,3) cost 1, (1,3) cost 2, (3,5) cost 2, and (3,4) cost 3 connects all five stations with total cost 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 = 8.

expected_algorithm.name: Kruskal's Algorithm
expected_algorithm.reason: Kruskal's Algorithm builds a minimum spanning tree by repeatedly adding the cheapest connection that does not create a cycle, giving the minimum connection cost.

hint: Sort all candidate connections by cost.
Pick the cheapest connection that does not connect two already-connected groups.
Use a disjoint-set structure to track which stations are already connected.
real_world_takeaway: A minimum spanning tree built with Kruskal's Algorithm gives the cheapest way to connect an entire transit network so every station is reachable.
